name: Strip Steak with Fried Egg, Bell Pepper-Onion Medley & Jalapeño Aioli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 red bell peppers
3 green bell peppers
1 ½ jalapeño peppers

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and medium dice onions; add to the baking sheets with the bell pepper. Drizzle veggies with oil, season with salt and pepper, then toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer steak to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside to rest. (Reserve skillet for later use.)

Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Add mayo, garlic powder, and salt to the bowl with the jalapeño. Stir to combine the aioli and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup avocado oil mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the steak is done, wipe the reserved skillet clean with paper towels, then return to medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add additional oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 eggs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide, steak, veggies, fried eggs, and aioli between plates. Enjoy!
